card.name: Just before a verb of making something better
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected verb meaning make, get, or become more or better (will, can, make, questions, world). The setting is general web text about a thing improving or growing.

modes.label: Subject or auxiliary before make
modes.description: A subject or helper word comes just before a verb like make or get that leads to a change.
modes.example: using only three unique numbers in your PIN instead of four different numbers<< will>> your make your PIN more secure

modes.label: Before a rise or improvement
modes.description: The next word is expected to say something becomes stronger, harder, or better.
modes.example: “If you keep getting answers correct, the<< questions>> will get harder.

card.writes: It pushes toward causative words like 使 and make, and away from the word increase and its forms.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to say that something makes or gets something better or greater.
